model: Stamp cards below the scrollport still built their text and thumbnail. content-visibility:auto skips that work until the card is near the viewport. The list card reserves 76px and the grid card reserves 148px so the scrollbar length stays stable.

noise.rule: n is rendered cards and v is cards in the scrollport. 20 and 4 are an example, not a live panel count. The latest list starts at 3 cards, so this applies once the list grows. Not a sampled paint trace.
